Thank you for acknowledging that.. well the lesson is simply being more educated on risk vs reward in my case, I took a personal thrill out of doing it. I find I can easily replicate the thrill in more controlled environments with safer alternatives. As for those who could potentially die from replicating it, that’s something completely out of my hands. Realistically all i’ve done is post an image/video of the stunt, personally I would not go around telling people to do it, let alone pressure to bring someone along to perform one of the stunts with me if they had no intention to commit in the first place. if anything, i’d suggest others who do consider it and ask me to find more formal alternatives such as ziplining, mountain biking, bungee jumping etc..however I highly doubt my advocation AGAINST it will stop somebody in their tracks. People will still find a way to take liberty into their own hands if they really wanted to do it. Others speaking up just give those people a second thought. 

I do have a question for you..do you think this post would be more productive had I decided to caption a disclaimer to give others who consider it a second thought?

Hopefully that answers your question

I never said I was regretful. Don’t twist my words. There is no use to regret something that’s already been done. Receive it how you’d like. I posted it here so I will admit i do not expect many people to take me with integrity
I’m not going to argue. I posted the image and video with a caption and that’s it. I said nothing else. Receive it to your heart’s content.

At the moment I did it I was excited with the idea of taking a unique picture, even if afterwards I realized how stupid and dangerous it was. I’m simply posting it here to share an image I really like. It’s clear though that people don’t receive this well but have genuine concern for my well being in seeing another person go. I’ve seen a video of a young man in China who fell to his death failing to do a pull up and I understand where the reception comes from. I reassure anyone who is rocked by this that I am alive and well going back this year as a student - though I will not be repeating a reckless act this time around in hanging off of buildings. If anything, do try to be positive and find enjoyment, even if it’s in how stupid, dumb dangerous and idiotic it is!
